name: scissor jumps (male)
description: An alternating split-stance jump that switches the front and back legs in the air. It raises the heart rate and challenges leg coordination.
instructions: Start in a split stance with one foot forward and the other behind you.
Bend both knees slightly and jump upward, switching your legs in the air.
Land softly with the opposite foot in front and your knees slightly bent.
Keep your torso steady and continue alternating the front and back legs at a controlled rhythm.
